svg.aria-label: Óptica Dr. Semeraro — optical clinic management system
svg.title: Óptica Dr. Semeraro — optical clinic management system
svg.text: Complete management system for an optical clinic: clinical records, prescriptions with diopter
formulas signed with a hash and QR, inventory and sales, plus a public patient portal. React
front end and NestJS API with role-based access control.
